concerns.location: plan.md:## Detailed Plan Phases → 8️⃣ Evaluation & Statistical Rigor
concerns.text: The plan does not include an *a priori* power analysis to justify the minimum dataset size (≥ 500 molecules). Without pre‑study power calculations, it is unclear whether the sample is sufficient to detect the expected effect size, risking under‑powered conclusions.

Temperature normalization is applied when a `temperature` column exists, otherwise the molecule is ‘flagged for uncertainty’. The handling of this uncertainty is not specified, which may introduce uncontrolled measurement noise and threaten construct validity of the refractive index target.

Scaffold splitting is stratified by RI quartile and molecular‑weight decile, but other potentially confounding chemical descriptors (e.g., functional‑group counts, hetero‑atom composition) are not accounted for. Residual confounds could bias the performance comparison between GNN and baseline.

concerns.location: plan.md:## 8️⃣ Evaluation & Statistical Rigor (FR‑006, SC‑001, SC‑002, SC‑003, SC‑004, SC‑005)
concerns.text: The paired statistical test is performed on per‑molecule errors, yet the plan does not describe how multiple testing across 25 splits will be aggregated or corrected, which may inflate Type I error rates.
